title: Universal 128 gate-depth lower bound for the scalar response
note: For the exact pinned scalar Poseidon2b response, bijectivity makes every one of the 128 response coordinates live. In the declared CNOT, one-qubit Clifford and T basis, each live fixed-register output bit requires its own active target gate; depth is at least one. Thus the universal gate-depth lower frontier is 128. This does not validate the published 200343274560 minimum premise or resolve the separate incomplete-construction accounting issue.
